_what: The credit a native own-records command is admitted for (src/own-resource-command-quota.mjs): a fixed part plus a part for each unit of its work (its source items, its page limit, or the nodes of its input, the largest of them). A row of `operations` replaces `default` for that operation alone; every other operation keeps `default`.

collections:project._why: Measured in a real workerd (test/collection-page-cost-workerd.test.mjs; rows read as the platform counts them): one discovery page costs about 8.4 statements, 4.8 rows read and 12.6 rows written per source of messages (5.2, 3.1 and 8.0 per list), flat from a store of 300 to 4,000 records. These are twice that. A source with a body larger than those records is still safe: the page stops between sources when the credit left cannot hold another of the costliest it has taken (src/native-own-collection-projection.mjs project), so it is never refused inside one.
